rowResize.text: Resizing · the same fleet at narrower terminals

emptyRules.text:
Empty lanes

A lane is empty only when it has no agents at all. Done or paused agents still hold their tiles; done tiles age out after 30m into the lane's '✓n recent' count.

Empty → wait 30s (debounce), then collapse to a 14-col rail: type, '0 agents', the stage list, last run, n new, ⏎ expand. Lane order never changes.

Freed width goes to open lanes: tile columns = round(4 × lane agents ÷ open agents), min 1. Here plan 2 / impl 8 → 1 : 3.

A new agent in a collapsed lane re-expands it at once (no debounce). z pins all lanes open for people who want fixed positions.

Selection survives every reflow.

All lanes empty → one centred idle screen: n new / p i d by type, plus today's recent runs.

80 cols: empty types show a one-line 'DEPLOY · 0 · n new' header.

resizeRules.text:
Agent types

The fleet is grouped into one lane per type: PLANNING (exploration › specification › validation), IMPLEMENTATION (setup › implementation › testing › pr › awaiting review › feedback implementation › closed), DEPLOY (setup › deploy › verify). Each lane header lists its stages and per-state counts.

Every tile carries a stage track, one segment per stage: 3 for plan and deploy, 7 for implementation, so the shape alone tells the type. Done stages muted, current stage in the status colour, later stages empty.

Resize rules (terminal columns)

≥140 → lanes 1 : 2 : 1 tile columns (plan · impl · deploy), 3 rows each; empty slots offer 'n new agent'. Detail = rail with the type's stages + artefact pane.

100–139 → three lanes, one tile column each, compact tiles; overflow shown as '↓n' in the lane header.

80–99 → list grouped under type headers, ■□ stage dots per row, preview of the selected agent. Detail = tab strip, one artefact at a time.

<80×24 → single centred 'too small' line; agents keep running.

On SIGWINCH: recompute layout, keep the selected agent and artefact, keep a following log pinned to the bottom, redraw ≤10 fps.
